qa_pairs.question: What type designation is given for the clamping bolt in the rocker arm?
Which section of the manual does this torque specification table belong to?
qa_pairs.answer: 11 - 23 Engine, section 11 33 Rocker Arms/Drag Arms and Bearings

qa_pairs.question: How many different clamping bolt specifications are shown in the Rocker Arms/Drag Arms and Bearings section?
qa_pairs.answer: 2 specifications - one for rocker arm and one for drag arm
